<title id="_acc1ed93-a6ba-9029-2acf-80ee3eae1d33">4. The anchor: tamper evidence</title>
<p id="_4b413da8-c989-a3c8-3c4e-72a3f74855f1">An append-only file with no anchor proves nothing — anyone can edit a line, or delete a run's records entirely, and the file still looks like a ledger. The anchor is a chained digest, sealed on demand and verified on demand, stored BESIDE the journal it covers and named by it:</p>

<sourcecode id="_040ac458-b349-1c79-8589-37f9b0fd332f"> <body>&lt;journal&gt;.seal          e.g. $TEBAKO_HOME/journal.log.seal</body> </sourcecode>
2
